implementation.targetScope: Framework-agnostic writable/computed/async atoms, subscriptions, batching, shallow comparison and Store/ReadonlyStore actions; current TanStack Table9.3.1 unchanged caller verified. Private signal-node structures and framework hooks excluded.

changes: Independent dependency graph: observed branches propagate invalidations; detached computations validate cached dependency versions on demand.
Listener failures drain remaining notifications and permit future updates; computation errors reach error observers and recover when inputs change.
Reentrant writes are delivered in coherent successive notification waves rather than losing a subscriber update.
Async completions are guarded by request identity; circular dependencies report an explicit error.

caller.name: @tanstack/table-core
caller.note: Prerequisite for the current Table upgrade, not an existing direct app Store import or a claim of adoption.
